Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here for poetry, Hale. The zero comes off. Who decided it?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
Neither am I here for games. Who entered the zero, and when?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
You've dodged one question three times. Answer it, or I'm going to the principal.

Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
By you, I take it. Before anyone spoke to Owen, or called me?
